name: jogo-de-navinha-agy-summit-26
description: Jogo de Navinha com Antigravity CLI para o Google Cloud Summit 2026

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build:mcps && npm run build:daemon && npm run build:player && npm run build:leaderboard
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=packages/shared && npm run test --workspace=packages/mcps && npm run test --workspace=packages/daemon
scripts.start:daemon: npm run kill:daemon && npm run build:daemon && npm run start --workspace=packages/daemon
scripts.start:player: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=packages/player-app
scripts.start:leaderboard: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=packages/leaderboard-app
scripts.dev:player: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=packages/player-app
scripts.dev:leaderboard: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=packages/leaderboard-app
scripts.dev:daemon: npm run build:shared && npm run dev --workspace=packages/daemon
